title_en: Kirby and the World Beyond Revealed With Gameplay Ahead of Spring 2027 Nintendo Switch 2 Launch
summary_en: Nintendo has revealed Kirby and the World Beyond with a first-look gameplay trailer ahead of its launch on Nintendo Switch 2.
body_en:
Nintendo has revealed Kirby and the World Beyond with a first-look gameplay trailer ahead of its launch on Nintendo Switch 2.
In what will almost surely come as a surprise for Super Smash Bros., Nintendogs, and even Kirby fans everywhere, everyone’s favorite powerful pink hero closed out today’s September 2026 Nintendo Direct. This first look at Kirby and the World Beyond came with an early look at gameplay, showing that, per usual, Kirby will be able to use his copy abilities to slay foes.
This looks like a much more open adventure than Nintendo has offered in the past. In fact, Kirby and the World Beyond might be Kirby’s most open experience yet when it launches for Nintendo Switch 2 spring 2027.
Kirby and the World Beyond releases spring 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2!
Get ready to explore the World Beyond using Copy Abilities in Kirby's latest 3D adventure. #NintendoDirect pic.twitter.com/JLtr5271Aa
In case you forgot, this is Nintendo’s second Direct of the week. For everything announced during yesterday’s Zelda Direct, click here . For everything announced during today’s Direct, click here .
